db_system_id.description:
The ID of the DbSystem to create. This value is
restricted to (^[a-z]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$) and must be a maximum of
63 characters in length. The value must start with a letter and end with a
letter or a number.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

deletion_protection.description: Whether or not to allow Terraform to destroy the instance. Unless this field is set to false in Terraform state, a terraform destroy or terraform apply that would delete the instance will fail.

display_name.description:
The display name for the System db. The name does not have to
be unique within your project.

gcp_oracle_zone.description:
The GCP Oracle zone where Oracle DbSystem is hosted.
Example: us-east4-b-r2.
If not specified, the system will pick a zone based on availability.

labels.description:
The labels or tags associated with the DbSystem.

**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.

location.description: Resource ID segment making up resource 'name'. It identifies the resource within its parent collection as described in https://google.aip.dev/122.
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

odb_network.description:
The name of the OdbNetwork associated with the DbSystem.
Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/odbNetworks/{odb_network}
It is optional but if specified, this should match the parent ODBNetwork of
the OdbSubnet.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

properties.compute_count.description: The number of CPU cores to enable for the DbSystem.

properties.compute_model.description:
The compute model of the DbSystem.
Possible values:
ECPU
OCPU

properties.data_storage_size_gb.description: The data storage size in GB that is currently available to DbSystems.

properties.database_edition.description:
The database edition of the DbSystem.
Possible values:
STANDARD_EDITION
ENTERPRISE_EDITION
ENTERPRISE_EDITION_HIGH_PERFORMANCE

properties.domain.description: The host domain name of the DbSystem.

properties.hostname_prefix.description: Prefix for DB System host names.

properties.initial_data_storage_size_gb.description: The initial data storage size in GB.

properties.license_model.description:
The license model of the DbSystem.
Possible values:
LICENSE_INCLUDED
BRING_YOUR_OWN_LICENSE

properties.node_count.description: The number of nodes in the DbSystem.

properties.private_ip.description: The private IP address of the DbSystem.

properties.reco_storage_size_gb.description: The reco/redo storage size in GB.

properties.ssh_public_keys.description: SSH public keys to be stored with the DbSystem.

properties.data_collection_options.is_di.description: Indicates whether to enable data collection for diagnostics.

properties.data_collection_options.is_in.description: Indicates whether to enable incident logs and trace collection.

properties.db_home.description: Details of the Database Home resource.

properties.db_home.db_version.description:
A valid Oracle Database version. For a list of supported versions, use the
ListDbVersions operation.

properties.db_home.display_name.description:
The display name for the Database Home. The name does not have to
be unique within your project.

properties.db_home.is_unified_auditing_e.description: Whether unified auditing is enabled for the Database Home.

properties.db_home.database.admin_passwo.description: The password for the default ADMIN user.

properties.db_home.database.character_se.description: The character set for the database. The default is AL32UTF8.

properties.db_home.database.database_id.description: The database ID of the Database.

properties.db_home.database.db_home_name.description: The name of the DbHome resource associated with the Database.

properties.db_home.database.db_name.description:
The database name. The name must begin with an alphabetic character and can
contain a maximum of eight alphanumeric characters. Special characters are
not permitted.

properties.db_home.database.db_unique_na.description: The DB_UNIQUE_NAME of the Oracle Database being backed up.

properties.db_home.database.gcp_oracle_z.description: The GCP Oracle zone where the Database is created.

properties.db_home.database.ncharacter_s.description: The national character set for the database. The default is AL16UTF16.

properties.db_home.database.pluggable_da.description: The ID of the pluggable database associated with Database. The ID must be unique within the project and location.
The pluggable dataabse associated with the Database. The name must begin with an alphabetic character and can contain a maximum of thirty alphanumeric characters.

properties.db_home.database.tde_wallet_p.description: The TDE wallet password for the database.

properties.db_home.database.properties.d.description: The configuration of the Database Management service.
If set to true, enables automatic backups on the database.

Possible values:
MONDAY
TUESDAY
WEDNESDAY
THURSDAY
FRIDAY
SATURDAY
SUNDAY

The window in which the full backup should be performed on the database.
If no value is provided, the default is anytime.
Possible values:
SLOT_ONE
SLOT_TWO
SLOT_THREE
SLOT_FOUR
SLOT_FIVE
SLOT_SIX
SLOT_SEVEN
SLOT_EIGHT
SLOT_NINE
SLOT_TEN
SLOT_ELEVEN
SLOT_TWELVE

The window in which the incremental backup should be performed on the
database. If no value is provided, the default is anytime except the auto
full backup day.
Possible values:
SLOT_ONE
SLOT_TWO
SLOT_THREE
SLOT_FOUR
SLOT_FIVE
SLOT_SIX
SLOT_SEVEN
SLOT_EIGHT
SLOT_NINE
SLOT_TEN
SLOT_ELEVEN
SLOT_TWELVE

This defines when the backups will be deleted after Database termination.
Possible values:
DELETE_IMMEDIATELY
DELETE_AFTER_RETENTION_PERIOD

The number of days an automatic backup is retained before being
automatically deleted. This value determines the earliest point in time to
which a database can be restored. Min: 1, Max: 60.
Details of the database backup destinations.

The type of the database backup destination.
Possible values:
NFS
RECOVERY_APPLIANCE
OBJECT_STORE
LOCAL
DBRS

properties.db_system_options.storage_man.description:
The storage option used in DB system.
Possible values:
ASM
LVM

properties.time_zone.description:
Represents a time zone from the
[IANA Time Zone Database](https://www.iana.org/time-zones).

properties.time_zone.id.description: IANA Time Zone Database time zone. For example "America/New_York".
